title: Gated control OFF really disables it: ordinary dispatch, queue progression, Resume and wakes run despite retained old control state
outcome: Gated control OFF really disables it: ordinary dispatch, queue progression, Resume and wakes run despite retained old control state
acceptance: An inventory, cited to source, lists every path where retained control state (grants, retained or unknown-outcome heads, session obligations, checkpoints, rebind or abort duties, old-duty guards) can withhold ordinary operation while turnGatedControl is false: fresh Human dispatch, queue progression and drain, Resume, mailbox and other wakes, and boot recovery

With turnGatedControl false, none of those paths is withheld by retained control state: an idle session with queued ordinary prompts (Human, mailbox wake, automated) dispatches them in order, Resume works on an empty or non-empty queue, and wakes start turns; each path is proven by a test driving a session that holds retained or unknown old control state

Old unknown-outcome operations are preserved separately with their ids, content, outcome and markers, never replayed, and never placed where they block ordinary operation at OFF; their settlement is not a precondition for anything at OFF

Runtime evidence after install: a live OFF session that held retained old control state dispatches a queued ordinary prompt and a wake without operator recovery action; a false setting alone is not accepted as proof
